subject: Portal ingress: CAIQ snapshot & delegated SSO proof
messages:
From: Alice Wu <alice.wu@brightleaf.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@brightleaf.com
Date: 2025-10-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Portal access request — CAIQ export + SOC2 artifacts

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro this week. We want to finish onboarding Brightleaf into your vendor portal so our security team can complete the assessment. Brightleaf can push a CAIQ export and SOC2 artifact bundle if we can get the following:

- Whistic or Vendr invitation to upload CAIQ (preferred format: CSV/JSON export)
- Temporary S3 presign or Drive folder where we can stage supporting documents (ISO/PCI/SOC2 report, penetration test summary)
- A contact and minimal list of required files (we have an internal Q&A spreadsheet attached)

I attached Brightleaf_Security_Q&A.xlsx — it's our standard intake. Can you confirm who on your side will accept the portal invite and whether Redwood requires a signed non-disclosure before upload?

Appreciate a short checklist and approximate timeline for onboarding.

Thanks,
Alice Wu
Security Operations
Brightleaf

Attachment: Brightleaf_Security_Q&A.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@brightleaf.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portal access request — CAIQ export + SOC2 artifacts

Hi Alice — welcome, and thanks for the spreadsheet.

Quick plan on our side:

1) We'll send a Whistic invite to security@brightleaf.com this afternoon. Whistic is our canonical portal for CAIQ/QnA ingestion; Vendr is used for procurement artifacts when needed.
2) For bulk evidence (SOC2 report, pen test summary) we prefer a short-lived Google Drive folder; I'll create one and share a staging link with edit access. If you must use S3 presigns, let me know and we'll loop infra.
3) No additional NDA required for the portal upload — we have a standard vendor confidentiality addendum in place for SOC artifacts, but we won't block uploads.

Action items for Brightleaf: accept the Whistic invite, export the CAIQ (JSON/CSV preferred), and place the SOC2 report and pen-test summary into the shared folder.

Karthik / Marissa — can you confirm the staging folder permissions and whether we need a service account for Archer ingestion (Brightleaf asked about Archer in one line of their intake)?

I'll follow up with the invite and a mutual action plan.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Ops (Vendor Security)
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-23T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portal access request — CAIQ export + SOC2 artifacts

Vanessa — quick tech notes below so we don't hit handoffs: 

- Whistic/Vendr: standard invites are fine. For automated CAIQ ingestion we accept JSON/CSV; for CAIQ v4 exports include the question id mapping (we map by question id + control name).
- Drive vs S3: Drive is fine for manual upload. If Brightleaf wants direct Archer ingestion we require a service-account key with least privilege and a signed access assertion (we'll provide a temp role and TTL). I've attached the Archer service-account checklist we use.
- Evidence manifest: ask Brightleaf to include a short manifest (manifest.json or manifest.csv) mapping filenames to control IDs — this reduces manual QA time.

Operational constraints: we can onboard the CAIQ import pipeline in ~3 business days from accepting the invite and receiving the CAIQ export + manifest. SOC2 report ingestion (scans for dates & scope) will take 1-2 business days after artifacts are staged.

Attachment: archer-svc-account-instructions.pdf (pdf)

Marissa — can you generate the shared Drive link and set the folder TTL to 14 days? Also confirm whether we should enable view-only or edit for external uploads.

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Infrastructure Engineer

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Alice — looping back with concrete next steps & timeline. Forwarding the short plan below (please accept the Whistic invite when it lands):

>

- Day 1–3: Redwood runs CAIQ import + evidence QA; follow-ups for missing artifacts.
